funds.name: Herd
funds.tagline: Crypto trends persist because the crowd reinforces itself. Herd rides the wave until it breaks.

funds.name: Washout
funds.tagline: Every pump gets sold, every dump gets bought. Washout bets on the overcorrection after every move larger than 3%.

funds.name: Degenerator
funds.tagline: Memecoins spike then die — but the spike lasts several ticks. Degenerator rides the momentum while it persists.

funds.name: Lockflow
funds.tagline: DeFi TVL moves slowly and with conviction. Lockflow only bets when TVL shifts by more than 2% — ignoring the noise between.

funds.name: Oracle
funds.tagline: Prediction markets converge to truth as events approach. Oracle rides the odds direction — the crowd gets smarter as resolution nears.

funds.name: Revert
funds.tagline: Temperature always returns to the seasonal mean. Every heatwave ends, every cold snap breaks. Revert bets on the return.

funds.name: Aftershock
funds.tagline: Earthquakes come in swarms. After a big one, the next ticks bring more. Aftershock bets on seismic persistence.

funds.name: Ember
funds.tagline: Fire season is fire season. Once hotspots appear in a region, Ember bets they grow — fires don't extinguish themselves between ticks.

funds.name: Clearsky
funds.tagline: AQI spikes are temporary. Smoke clears, winds shift, rain falls. Clearsky bets on recovery after every pollution event.

funds.name: Swell
funds.tagline: Ocean swells propagate across basins for days. A storm generates waves that persist tick-over-tick. Swell rides the propagation.

funds.name: Aurora
funds.tagline: Solar storms come in bursts — a high Kp index this tick means elevated activity next tick. Aurora bets on solar persistence.

funds.name: Cascade
funds.tagline: Transit disruptions cascade. One stuck train creates thirty delayed ones. Cascade bets that disruption persists once it starts.

funds.name: Tailwind
funds.tagline: Flight delays resolve. The system recovers by next cycle. Tailwind bets on normalization after disruption.

funds.name: Gridlock
funds.tagline: Rush hour traffic builds on itself. Gridlock bets that congestion this tick will be worse next tick — the commute only deepens.

funds.name: Crossing
funds.tagline: Border waits compound. When lines form, more cars arrive, fewer get processed. Crossing bets that long waits get longer within the same day.

funds.name: Spoke
funds.tagline: Empty bike racks refill. Late trains catch up. Spoke bets on mean-reversion in transit systems designed to self-balance.

funds.name: Prime Time
funds.tagline: Viewership begets viewership. When a streamer is hot, more viewers pile in tick-over-tick. Prime Time bets that rising counts keep rising within a session.

funds.name: Weekend
funds.tagline: Gamers play. Steam concurrent players trend up more often than down. Weekend applies a structural long bias to gaming activity.

funds.name: Hivemind
funds.tagline: Subreddit growth is viral. Once a community starts gaining subscribers, network effects accelerate it tick-over-tick. Hivemind rides the viral phase.

funds.name: Decay
funds.tagline: Every HN story peaks and falls. A high-score story this tick will have fewer points next tick. Decay fades the hype — reliably.

funds.name: Season
funds.tagline: Anime popularity spikes at season premiere and sustains for weeks. Season bets that a trending show stays trending tick-over-tick.

funds.name: Noise
funds.tagline: 4chan activity spikes are pure chaos. Every surge crashes back to baseline within a few ticks. Noise fades every spike.

funds.name: Homecourt
funds.tagline: Home teams win 55-60% across all sports. Homecourt applies a systematic home-team bias — simple, persistent, profitable at scale.

funds.name: Hawkish
funds.tagline: Central banks move in cycles. A rate shift this tick predicts another next tick. Hawkish rides the policy direction until the rhetoric turns.

funds.name: Payroll
funds.tagline: Jobs data overshoots every tick. Markets overreact to every release. Payroll fades the surprise — strong data revises down, weak data revises up.

funds.name: Barrel
funds.tagline: Energy prices trend in regimes. When production shifts, the effect persists for many ticks. Barrel follows the supply-demand narrative.

funds.name: Glacier
funds.tagline: Development indicators move at geological speed. Glacier only bets when something actually changes — which is rare, but when it does, it persists.

funds.name: Spread
funds.tagline: Rate differentials oscillate. When one central bank moves too far from another, convergence pulls them back. Spread bets on the pull.

funds.name: Adoption
funds.tagline: Package downloads follow adoption S-curves. Rising downloads keep rising tick-over-tick — network effects in the dependency graph.

funds.name: Trending
funds.tagline: GitHub stars spike when a repo gets attention. The spike sustains for several ticks before decay. Trending rides the first wave.

funds.name: Resilience
funds.tagline: Internet outages resolve. Infrastructure teams fix things. Resilience bets on recovery — connectivity always comes back.

funds.name: Overflow
funds.tagline: When a technology gains questions, it's gaining adopters. More questions mean more developers. Overflow rides the flywheel.

funds.name: Deadline
funds.tagline: SEC filings cluster around deadlines. Filing volume builds tick-over-tick during disclosure windows. Deadline rides the surge.

funds.name: Session
funds.tagline: When Congress votes, it keeps voting. Legislative activity has momentum — a busy tick predicts another busy tick.

funds.name: Complaint
funds.tagline: NYC complaint spikes resolve. The city returns to its baseline whining within a few ticks. Complaint fades every surge.

funds.name: Migration
funds.tagline: Birds migrate on schedule. When sightings start increasing, they accelerate for many ticks. Migration bets on the biological clock.

funds.name: Preprint
funds.tagline: Research output clusters around grant cycles. A publishing surge sustains for several ticks. Preprint rides the academic rhythm.

funds.name: Torrent
funds.tagline: River discharge rises for many ticks after rainfall. Water flows downhill and accumulates. Torrent rides the hydrological lag.

funds.name: Tideline
funds.tagline: Tides are periodic. What goes up comes down, every 12 hours. Tideline bets on reversal — the most predictable mean-reversion in nature.

funds.name: Fastpass
funds.tagline: Theme park lines peak at 2pm and shrink by closing. Every ride has capacity that forces mean-reversion. Fastpass fades the midday rush.

funds.name: Soft Serve
funds.tagline: Broken ice cream machines get fixed. McDonald's maintenance cycles are 24-48 hours. Soft Serve bets on repair.

funds.name: After Dark
funds.tagline: Viewership follows the clock — evening means rising viewers. After Dark bets that peak-hour momentum sustains tick-over-tick.

funds.name: Unusual
funds.tagline: TF2 hat prices are driven by community consensus. When an item climbs, collectors pile in. Unusual rides the speculative wave.
